summary:
Comprehensive Engineering Implementation Plan for DeshiMart Mobile Routing & Directional Navigation:
- Establishes smart hierarchical back-navigation across all app flows (Catalog, Checkout, Tracking, Account, Comparison).
- Maps default hierarchical fallback parents for every ScreenId when history stack is shallow or multi-entry.
- Implements directional flow awareness (forward, backward, root tab switch) with motion transition support.
- Hardens browser PopState & hardware back-button synchronization.
- Enforces checkout flow immutability to prevent re-entering completed checkout stages after order placement.
